name: Flying swords
look: Flying-sword formation from cultivation fantasy. Eight slim glowing spirit swords orbit the character in a ring at chest height, points outward, trailing faint cyan light.
subject: shield

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the ring of eight swords alone as they orbit, no trails, no glow

parts.name: SWORD
parts.text: one spirit sword alone, upright, blade, guard and hilt clear
forms: seen point-on as it turns toward the viewer, short

parts.name: TRAIL
parts.text: one sword's cyan light trail alone

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: cyan sparks, a clash flash, metal glints

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the glow of the swords and their trails, the light it gives off, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes, opaque, with no glow, no sparks and no specks

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: sparks, specks, chips, flecks and puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft light round the shapes and the effects, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: the swords fan out from behind the character's back and spread into the ring
notes: only a few faint specks of light, under 20 pixels: the shape is not visible yet
the whole effect fully formed, exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet, as big as in every other moment

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the swords orbit steadily round the character, light trails behind each; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow comes from the right; the swords swing together to the right side, cross into a barrier and sparks burst where the blow meets them

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the swords stop, then fly off outward in every direction and vanish as streaks
notes: a few last faint specks, under 20 pixels
